gold.user: As a project manager, I want to retrieve all notification schemes available in the Jira Cloud platform so that I can understand how notifications are configured across different projects.
gold.ideal: The API should return a list of all notification schemes with their respective IDs and names, allowing me to identify which schemes are in use.

gold.user: As a Jira administrator, I want to create a new notification scheme for my project to ensure that team members receive updates on relevant issues.
gold.ideal: The API should accept the necessary parameters for the new notification scheme and return the created scheme's ID and details.

gold.user: As a project lead, I need to check which notification schemes are mapped to my projects to ensure that notifications are sent to the right users.
gold.ideal: The API should return a mapping of projects to their corresponding notification schemes, including project IDs and scheme IDs.

gold.user: As a developer, I want to view the details of a specific notification scheme to understand its configuration and the notifications it triggers.
gold.ideal: The API should return the details of the specified notification scheme, including its name, description, and the notifications associated with it.

gold.user: As a project administrator, I need to update an existing notification scheme to modify the recipients of certain notifications based on team changes.
gold.ideal: The API should accept the updated details and return the updated notification scheme's information, confirming the changes.

gold.user: As a project manager, I want to add new notifications to an existing notification scheme to ensure that additional team members receive important updates.
gold.ideal: The API should allow me to specify the notifications to add and return the updated list of notifications in the scheme.

gold.user: As a Jira administrator, I want to delete an obsolete notification scheme that is no longer in use to keep the system organized.
gold.ideal: The API should confirm the deletion of the notification scheme and return a success message.

gold.user: As a project lead, I need to remove a specific notification from a notification scheme to prevent unnecessary alerts being sent to users.
gold.ideal: The API should confirm the removal of the notification and return the updated list of notifications in the scheme.
